fcdcfc098f5d3348.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة حسن انس فارسي القابضة عن فني كهربائي تمديدات كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية، وتقدير المواد، ومتابعة التنفيذ، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص الأعطال ومعالجتها. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في المجال. المسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى شاغل الوظيفة مجموعة من المهام الأساسية لضمان كفاءة وسلامة التمديدات الكهربائية، وتشمل هذه المهام ما يلي: دراسة وتحليل مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية لمختلف التطبيقات (المنزلية، الصناعية، التجارية) ومكوناتها. تقدير الكميات المطلوبة من المواد والأجهزة الكهربائية، وتأمين التجهيزات اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال التمديدات مع مطابقة مواصفاتها. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال التمديدات الكهربائية، ومراقبة تشغيل الدارات الكهربائية، وإجراء الفحوصات اللازمة مثل فحوص العازلية والاستمرارية والتأريض. تشخيص أعطال التمديدات الكهربائية وتحديد الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة لمعالجتها، بالإضافة إلى متابعة أعمال الصيانة الوقائية. تطبيق جميع إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة. المؤهلات والخبرة يتطلب هذا الدور مرشحاً يمتلك المؤهلات والخبرات التالية: خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال التمديدات الكهربائية. القدرة على قراءة وفهم المخططات الكهربائية. معرفة جيدة بمواد وأجهزة التمديدات الكهربائية ومواصفاتها. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والصحة المهنية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في المدينة المنورة ضمن فريق عمل شركة حسن انس فارسي القابضة. يتوقع من الفني العمل في بيئات مختلفة تتطلب تطبيق المعرفة الفنية والالتزام بمعايير السلامة. عن الشركة شركة حسن انس فارسي القابضة هي كيان يعمل في المدينة المنورة ويسعى لضم الكفاءات المتخصصة إلى فريقه لتعزيز جودة الخدمات والأعمال المقدمة. تقديم الطلبات للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عمل شركة حسن انس فارسي القابضة، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم لهذه الوظيفة في المدينة المنورة.

fc5157e52fdc3eee.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة كوينتوم بيلدرز عن أخصائي مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تسويق وبيع بطاريات شحن المركبات الكهربائية للأفراد، واستقطاب عملاء جدد، وتحقيق المستهدفات البيعية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تسويق وبيع بطاريات شحن المركبات الكهربائية للأفراد (B2C). استقطاب العملاء الجدد وشرح مواصفات ومميزات البطاريات. تقديم العروض السعرية ومتابعة العملاء لإتمام عمليات البيع. تحقيق المستهدفات البيعية المحددة. وضع سياسات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها وتقييم النتائج. دراسة ومتابعة تطورات السوق وتحديد الأهداف التسويقية وطرق البيع. تقدير حجم المبيعات المتوقع وترجمة الأهداف إلى خطط بيعية. اقتراح سياسات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها وتقييم البرامج الترويجية. التواصل مع الزبائن لتحديد مشكلاتهم ومتابعة المنافسين وبرامجهم البيعية. تقييم نتائج أعمال مندوبي البيع ومدى تحقيق الأهداف البيعية واقتراح الإجراءات التصحيحية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالمبيعات وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال المبيعات. القدرة على استقطاب العملاء الجدد وبناء علاقات قوية. فهم جيد لعمليات البيع والتسويق. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. القدرة على التفاوض وإتمام الصفقات. مهارات تحليل السوق وتحديد الفرص البيعية. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في الرياض، وتتطلب الوظيفة التزامًا بدوام كامل. سيتم العمل ضمن فريق مبيعات ديناميكي يهدف إلى تحقيق الأهداف المحددة للشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

fcd308a80a4b22ca.description: About the Role International Maritime Industries is seeking a Commissioning Superintendent Electrical to oversee electrical pre-commissioning and commissioning activities for new-build offshore jack-up drilling rigs. This full-time position is based in Ras Al Khair, Eastern, Saudi Arabia, and requires extensive experience in the field. Role Overview The Commissioning Superintendent Electrical will be responsible for the planning, coordination, execution, testing, energization, integration, and handover of electrical systems. This includes power generation and distribution, drilling and machinery drive systems, marine and jacking systems, safety and control systems, and hazardous area installations. The primary objective is to ensure safe and compliant system operation, operational readiness, successful project delivery, and client acceptance in accordance with project specifications, class requirements, and offshore regulatory standards. Key Responsibilities Lead the development of commissioning procedures, test packs, inspection and test records (ITRs), commissioning schedules, and system boundaries. Coordinate design reviews, risk assessments, factory acceptance tests, and readiness reviews to ensure commissioning preparedness and execution efficiency. Direct the commissioning, testing, energization, and performance verification of generators, alternators, switchboards, MCCs, power distribution systems, protection relays, and Power Management Systems (PMS). Manage the commissioning and functional testing of AC/DC variable frequency drives, drilling machinery, auxiliary drives, interlocks, and control logic interfaces. Oversee the commissioning and integration of jacking, skidding, ballast, bilge, navigation, emergency, and associated marine electrical systems. Lead cause-and-effect testing, functional verification, and integration of emergency shutdown (ESD), fire and gas (F&G), BOP control, UPS, battery backup, and emergency power systems. Oversee the inspection, validation, and certification compliance of hazardous area electrical installations and Ex-proof equipment in accordance with IECEx, ATEX, and applicable industry standards. Direct electrical testing, continuity verification, insulation resistance testing, loop checking, system energization, fault diagnosis, and corrective actions. Manage commissioning interfaces with engineering, construction, instrumentation, automation, mechanical disciplines, OEM vendors, class authorities, and client representatives. Champion compliance with LOTO, PTW, JSA, SIMOPS, project QHSE requirements, and applicable ABS, DNV, API, IEC, IEEE, IMO, and shipyard standards. Oversee commissioning dossiers, test records, punch-list management, readiness reviews, client acceptance activities, and system turnover packages. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in electrical commissioning, preferably within the offshore drilling or marine industries. Demonstrated expertise in power generation and distribution systems, drilling and machinery drive systems, and safety and control systems. Familiarity with hazardous area electrical installations and Ex-proof equipment standards (IECEx, ATEX). Strong understanding of offshore regulatory standards and class requirements (ABS, DNV, API, IEC, IEEE, IMO). Proficiency in managing commissioning procedures, test packs, and documentation. Work Environment This is a full-time position located in Ras Al Khair, Eastern, Saudi Arabia, with potential work in Ras Tannurah. The role involves working on new-build offshore jack-up drilling rigs, requiring adherence to stringent safety and quality standards.

fc8bc90fb9eec1ce.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة النخلات الثلاث للتجاره عن مشرف مكتب للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى الإشراف على العمليات المكتبية اليومية وضمان سيرها بسلاسة وفعالية وفقًا للخطط المحددة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الإشراف المكتبي. المسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف اليومي على جميع أعمال المكتب لضمان تنفيذ الإجراءات بسلاسة وفعالية. مراقبة جدولة المواعيد والتأكد من حسن سيرها وفقًا للخطط الموضوعة. ضمان تنظيم المكتب ونظافته بشكل مستمر، واتخاذ الإجراءات اللازمة للحفاظ على ذلك. التأكد من توافر جميع المستلزمات المكتبية الضرورية عند الحاجة، ووفقًا للخطط المعتمدة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الإشراف المكتبي أو دور مماثل. القدرة على الإشراف على العمليات اليومية وضمان الامتثال للخطط. مهارات تنظيمية وإدارية قوية. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مكة المكرمة، المملكة العربية السعودية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الحضور المنتظم في المكتب. نوع التوظيف هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مجموعة النخلات الثلاث للتجاره. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية التوظيف.

fc2b23066fa3333e.description: About Tamara Tamara is a prominent fintech platform operating in Saudi Arabia and the GCC region. The Role: Senior Data Engineering Manager Tamara is seeking a Senior Data Engineering Manager to lead a critical area within its engineering organization in Riyadh. This full-time role involves accountability for delivery and technical strategy across multiple complex product domains. The manager will lead a high-performing team of 6-10 senior engineers, potentially structured across two squads, and will drive team-level goals aligned with broader organizational priorities. The position requires leveraging deep expertise in software development and proven leadership to guide the architectural evolution of systems, ensuring reliability, scalability, and performance. Key Responsibilities Inspire and guide senior engineers, setting a clear direction aligned with the company vision. Drive alignment between technology goals and product priorities, advocating for long-term technical quality alongside short-term delivery. Develop direct reports and skip-levels for future leadership roles, creating growth opportunities for senior engineers and mentoring aspiring managers. Lead architectural discussions for the team's systems and drive continuous improvements to system reliability, performance, and scalability. Define and own delivery plans for initiatives spanning multiple teams, managing resource allocation and hiring strategy for the area. fc3887cc92336b44.description: About CAMCO - Capital Metro Company CAMCO – Capital Metro Company is a Saudi-French joint venture formed by RATP Dev and SAPTCO. With over 3,000 employees, CAMCO plays a key role in operating one of the world's largest fully automated metro networks, ensuring safe, reliable, and efficient metro services across Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The Role of Signalling Technician The Signalling Technician is responsible for executing preventive and corrective maintenance of signalling equipment. This role involves analyzing disruptions, implementing preventive measures in collaboration with supervisors and external providers, and troubleshooting systems and equipment to ensure operational integrity. Adhere to all required safety rules, regulations, and procedures. Perform other related tasks as assigned by superiors. Qualifications and Experience Vocational training in Electronics or Communications Systems is required. A minimum of 2-3 years of relevant work experience in the maintenance of system signalling assets is necessary. Experience in a railway or metro organization, or other relevant industry, is preferred. Preference will be given to qualified Saudi nationals. Work Environment This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within a dynamic operational environment that supports one of the world's largest automated metro networks.

fc9a3421b82bd1f2.description: About the Role CPV Arabia is seeking a Senior Welding Inspection Engineer to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. fc258f23cd507430.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث شركة أفراس للتجارة والمقاولات عن سائق سيارة خاص للانضمام إلى فريقها في أبها، بمنطقة عسير. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية قيادة السيارة لنقل الركاب، مع الالتزام التام بقواعد المرور والسلامة. الدور بدوام كامل ويشمل إجراء الفحوصات الدورية للسيارة ورفع طلبات الصيانة اللازمة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية قيادة السيارة لنقل الركاب مع ضمان الالتزام بالمواعيد المحددة، والتبليغ الفوري عن أي تأخير اضطراري. الالتزام الصارم بجميع قواعد المرور والأمن والسلامة، والتأكد من عدم ارتكاب أي مخالفات نظامية. إجراء فحوصات دورية منتظمة للسيارة لمعالجة المشكلات البسيطة التي قد تظهر. رفع طلبات الصيانة اللازمة التي تتطلب فحص الخبراء عند ملاحظة أي خلل أثناء القيادة. الالتزام التام بالأدلة والإجراءات التشغيلية، بالإضافة إلى أدلة المواصفات والمعايير وسياسات وقواعد السلامة العامة. المؤهلات والمتطلبات خبرة سابقة في مجال قيادة السيارات الخاصة أو ما يعادلها. حيازة شهادة قياس مستوى الكفاءة في القيادة. معرفة قوية بمبادئ وممارسات القيادة الآمنة والقدرة على الحفاظ على سجل قيادة خالٍ من المخالفات. بيئة العمل تتطلب الوظيفة العمل بدوام كامل في مدينة أبها، ضمن فريق شركة أفراس للتجارة والمقاولات. يجب على المتقدم أن يكون مستعدًا للالتزام بجدول زمني منتظم لضمان نقل الركاب بكفاءة وأمان. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الوظيفة في شركة أفراس للتجارة والمقاولات.

fcef49194da6aa5c.description: About the Role Fakeeh Care Group is seeking a Risk Manager to lead the development and enforcement of comprehensive health, safety, and risk management programs within its facilities. fc24e61d7cb0a143.description: About the Role Airbus Americas Customer Services, Inc. is seeking an Upgrade Services Project Manager (Systems / Airframe) to join their team in Al Qatif. An informal and inclusive culture: An open and welcoming environment where people come first, diversity is embraced, team spirit is strong and colleagues are approachable. International collaboration: The opportunity to work with passionate and supportive colleagues in Saudi Arabia and across other Haskoning offices, while contributing to diverse regional and international projects. fc604c30455c32ce.description: أولًا: إعلانات جوجل (Google Ads) إنشاء وإدارة حملات البحث (Search) ، التسوق (Shopping) ، Performance Max ، الشبكة الإعلانية (Display) ، ويوتيوب . البحث عن الكلمات المفتاحية وإدارة الكلمات السلبية وتحسين نقاط الجودة (Quality Score). كتابة نصوص إعلانية فعّالة واختبار أكثر من نسخة (A/B Testing). إجادة استخدام Google Tag Manager & Google Search Console إعداد وتحسين استراتيجيات المزايدة (Bidding) بما يحقق أهداف التكلفة والعائد . ثانيًا: إعلانات منصات التواصل (Paid Social) إدارة الحملات على إنستجرام، TikTok ، Snapchat ، و X حسب احتياج الشركة . بناء واستهداف الجماهير : Custom Audiences ، Lookalike ، وجماهير إعادة الاستهداف (Retargeting). إعداد حملات الوعي، التفاعل، الزيارات، الرسائل، والتحويلات والمبيعات . إدارة إعلانات الكتالوج الديناميكية (Catalog / Dynamic Ads). اختبار الكريتيف والرسائل الإعلانية بشكل مستمر لمعرفة الأفضل أداءً . ثالثًا: إدارة الميزانية والتخطيط وضع خطة إعلانية شهرية وتوزيع الميزانية على المنصات والحملات حسب الأداء . متابعة الإنفاق اليومي والتأكد من عدم تجاوز الميزانية المعتمدة . إيقاف الحملات الضعيفة وتوسيع الحملات الناجحة (Scaling) بشكل مدروس . التخطيط للمواسم والعروض (رمضان، العيد، الجمعة البيضاء، العودة للمدارس…) . رابعًا: التتبع والتحليل والتقارير إعداد أدوات التتبع : Meta Pixel و Conversions API ، Google Tag Manager ، GA4 ، TikTok Pixel ، وتتبع التحويلات . تحليل أداء الحملات يوميًا واستخراج رؤى قابلة للتنفيذ . إعداد تقارير أسبوعية وشهرية توضح النتائج والتكلفة والعائد والتوصيات . تحليل المنافسين ومتابعة اتجاهات السوق ومكتبات الإعلانات .

fc6b2806dac06c4c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الفارس للحراسات الامنية عن حارس أمن للانضمام إلى فريقها في تبوك. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى حماية الممتلكات والحفاظ على النظام من خلال المراقبة الدورية والتحكم في الدخول والخروج. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مراقبة عمليات الدخول إلى المنشأة ومغادرتها، وإصدار التصاريح اللازمة لذلك. التحقق من هوية الموردين والزوار وتسجيل بياناتهم، وإصدار تصاريح الدخول لهم. القيام بدوريات منتظمة في أماكن العمل، وتفقد البوابات والأبواب والنوافذ لضمان سلامتها. المرور بين الزوار والموظفين للحفاظ على النظام وحماية الممتلكات، ونشر اللوائح الداخلية للمنشأة. الاستجابة الفورية للإنذارات والتحقيق في الحوادث، والتواصل مع إدارات مكافحة الحرائق أو الإسعاف أو الشرطة عند الضرورة، وإبلاغ الإدارة بالوقائع. الالتزام الصارم بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها في المنشأة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال الحراسات الأمنية أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على مراقبة الممتلكات وحمايتها من السرقة والتخريب. القدرة على التعامل مع حالات الطوارئ والاستجابة السريعة للإنذارات. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات جيدة في الملاحظة والانتباه للتفاصيل. القدرة على التواصل الفعال والتعامل مع مختلف الأفراد. الالتزام بالتعليمات والسياسات والإجراءات الأمنية. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق. بيئة العمل يعمل حارس الأمن في تبوك بدوام كامل ضمن بيئة تتطلب اليقظة والانضباط. يتضمن الدور القيام بدوريات منتظمة ومراقبة مستمرة لضمان أمن وسلامة المنشأة والأفراد. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

The role ensures high-quality food preparation, proper hygiene, food safety compliance, and effective inventory control while minimizing waste and maintaining kitchen efficiency. Key Responsibilities 1. Meat Preparation & Production Prepare, cut, debone, trim, and portion meat, poultry, and seafood according to established recipes and hotel standards. Ensure all meat products meet the required quality, freshness, and presentation standards. Prepare meat portions according to daily operational requirements, banquet functions, and restaurant demands. Maintain consistency in portion sizes to support food cost control. Coordinate with the Executive Chef and Sous Chef regarding daily production requirements. 2. Food Safety & Hygiene Follow HACCP standards and hotel food safety policies. Ensure proper handling, labeling, dating, and storage of all meat products. Maintain appropriate refrigeration and freezer temperatures. Prevent cross-contamination by following proper sanitation procedures. Ensure all equipment, knives, cutting boards, and working areas are cleaned and sanitized regularly. Comply with local municipality regulations and hotel hygiene standards. 3. Inventory & Cost Control Monitor meat inventory and report shortages to the Sous Chef. Apply FIFO (First In, First Out) principles to minimize food waste. Inspect incoming meat deliveries for freshness, quality, and correct quantities. Ensure proper utilization of meat products to reduce unnecessary wastage. Support the kitchen team in maintaining food costs within the approved budget. 4. Equipment & Workplace Safety Operate butchery equipment safely, including meat slicers, grinders, knives, and cutting machines. Maintain all tools and equipment in good working condition. Report equipment damage or maintenance requirements immediately. Follow occupational health and safety procedures. Maintain a clean, organized, and safe butchery working environment. 5. Teamwork & Operational Support Coordinate with other kitchen sections to ensure smooth daily operations. Support banquet preparation and special events when required. Assist the Executive Chef with special meat preparation requests. Participate in departmental training and food safety programs. Perform other duties assigned by the Executive Chef or Sous Chef. Qualifications & Experience Culinary certification or relevant vocational training is preferred. Minimum 2 years of experience as a Butcher, preferably within a hotel or hospitality environment. Strong knowledge of meat cuts, deboning, trimming, and portion control. Knowledge of HACCP and food safety standards. Experience operating professional butchery equipment. Basic English communication skills. Ability to work flexible shifts, including weekends and public holidays. Required Skills & Competencies Excellent knife-handling and meat preparation skills. Strong attention to detail and quality. Good understanding of food hygiene and sanitation. Ability to work efficiently under pressure. Effective time management and organizational skills. Teamwork and communication. Knowledge of food cost control and waste reduction. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Compliance with food safety and hygiene standards. Consistency in meat quality and portion sizes. Reduction of meat wastage. Effective inventory rotation and storage. Timely completion of daily production requirements. Cleanliness and maintenance of the butchery section. General Responsibilities Demonstrate the hotel's service standards and IHG values. Comply with all hotel policies and procedures. Maintain professional grooming and personal hygiene standards. Support the hotel in achieving operational excellence and guest satisfaction. Carry out any additional duties reasonably assigned by management. Preferred candidate Years of experience 1+ years Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

fc2c1df64aff4911.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الصيانة السعودية صيانكو عن مشرف صيانة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى الإشراف على جميع جوانب عمليات الصيانة، من التخطيط إلى التنفيذ والتقييم، لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة وفعالية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الصيانة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة إجراءات تحديد نوع وطبيعة الصيانة المطلوبة، وتقدير كمية وتكلفة المواد اللازمة لإتمامها. توزيع المهام والواجبات على أعضاء فريق الصيانة بناءً على إمكاناتهم وقدراتهم الفردية. متابعة وتقييم أداء فريق الصيانة بشكل دوري، وتقييم إنجازاتهم لضمان تحقيق الأهداف المحددة. تقييم الاحتياجات التدريبية لفرق الصيانة، وتنمية مهاراتهم، أو التوصية بإلحاقهم ببرامج تدريبية متخصصة عند الحاجة. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية والإشراف على إجراءات تنفيذها لضمان استمرارية عمل المعدات والأنظمة. تصنيف وترتيب وتوثيق وحفظ نتائج العمل والتقارير المتعلقة بالصيانة بشكل منهجي. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الصيانة أو دور إشرافي مماثل. فهم قوي لإجراءات الصيانة الوقائية والتصحيحية. القدرة على تقييم الاحتياجات وتوزيع المهام بفعالية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قيادية وإشرافية قوية. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والتنظيم. القدرة على تحليل المشكلات واتخاذ القرارات. إتقان إعداد التقارير وتوثيق العمليات. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض. سيعمل مشرف الصيانة ضمن فريق متخصص، ويكون مسؤولاً عن الإشراف المباشر على عمليات الصيانة لضمان الجودة والكفاءة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال عملية التوظيف. ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم.

fc8213540cea1682.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة كرمة إعمار للمقاولات عن أخصائي عمليات موارد بشرية للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الخبر. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إدارة العمليات اليومية للموارد البشرية، ويشمل تحديث ملفات الموظفين وتنفيذ الإجراءات المتعلقة بالتوظيف والعقود والإجازات والحضور والانصراف. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إدارة العمليات اليومية للموارد البشرية بفعالية. تحديث وحفظ ملفات الموظفين وبياناتهم بشكل دقيق ومنظم. تنفيذ الإجراءات المتعلقة بالتوظيف والمباشرة وإنهاء الخدمة. إعداد ومتابعة عقود العمل وتجديدها وفقاً للسياسات المعتمدة. متابعة سجلات الحضور والانصراف والإجازات للموظفين. التنسيق الفعال مع قسم الرواتب لضمان دقة البيانات. ضمان الالتزام التام بسياسات الشركة ونظام العمل المعمول به. المهام الإضافية الرد على استفسارات الموظفين المتعلقة بسياسات العمل والإجازات. تقديم الدعم اللازم للموظفين في المسائل المتعلقة بالموارد البشرية. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال عمليات الموارد البشرية. فهم جيد لسياسات الموارد البشرية وأنظمة العمل. القدرة على إدارة ملفات الموظفين وتحديث البيانات بدقة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة الخبر بالمنطقة الشرقية. يتطلب العمل ضمن فريق الموارد البشرية لضمان سير العمليات بسلاسة وفعالية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

fc9655563704dcfb.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ديار الشرق الاوسط لتكنولوجيا المعلومات عن أخصائي إدارة مخاطر للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يدعم هذا الدور مبادرات الحوكمة والمخاطر والامتثال (GRC) عبر بيئات العملاء في المملكة العربية السعودية. يتطلب الدور معرفة قوية بمعايير تكنولوجيا المعلومات والأمن السيبراني، مع خبرة محددة في الأطر التنظيمية المحلية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تطوير وتطبيق وصيانة أطر وسياسات وإجراءات الحوكمة والمخاطر والامتثال (GRC). إجراء تقييمات المخاطر وتحليل الفجوات ومراجعات الامتثال. ضمان التوافق مع المعايير الدولية مثل ISO 27001، NIST CSF، وCOBIT. تفسير وتطبيق اللوائح المحلية بما في ذلك أطر عمل البنك المركزي السعودي (SAMA) والهيئة الوطنية للأمن السيبراني (NCA). دعم أنشطة التدقيق (الداخلي والخارجي) وتتبع معالجة الملاحظات. التعاون مع فرق تكنولوجيا المعلومات والأمن لترسيخ الضوابط وتدابير تخفيف المخاطر. التواصل مع أصحاب المصلحة رفيعي المستوى، بما في ذلك المدير التنفيذي للمعلومات والمدير التنفيذي للأمن السيبراني والجهات التنظيمية. تقديم المشورة لأصحاب المصلحة بشأن تخفيف المخاطر والامتثال التنظيمي. إعداد التقارير ولوحات المعلومات والعروض التقديمية لأصحاب المصلحة والقيادة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال إدارة المخاطر أو الحوكمة أو الامتثال. معرفة قوية بمعايير تكنولوجيا المعلومات والأمن السيبراني. خبرة محددة في الأطر التنظيمية المحلية في المملكة العربية السعودية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. سيعمل أخصائي إدارة المخاطر ضمن فريق متخصص لدعم العملاء في بيئات متنوعة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد عملية التقديم والمقابلات.

fcf3bd4ad70242a7.job_title: Director of Housekeeping, Four seasons Riyadh
fcf3bd4ad70242a7.description: Job description About Four Seasons: Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture. At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us. About the location: An architectural icon in the heart of Saudi Arabia’s vibrant capital soaring over the city in the iconic Kingdom Tower, Four Seasons Hotel Riyadh is a buzzing hub at the forefront of style and sophistication. Redesigned interiors bring authentic Saudi heritage and craftsmanship to life, while our distinguished team provides a bespoke experience through thoughtful, personalized service and hospitality. As Director of Housekeeping, you will be responsible for overseeing all housekeeping operations to ensure the highest standards of cleanliness, comfort, presentation, and safety throughout the hotel. You will lead the Housekeeping team in delivering exceptional guest experiences while maintaining Four Seasons standards of service and operational excellence. You will develop and implement effective departmental strategies, manage budgets and operating expenses, optimize productivity, and ensure the efficient allocation of resources. You will also be responsible for maintaining the highest standards in guest rooms, suites, public areas, and other designated spaces, ensuring that all areas reflect the hotel's luxury positioning. Working closely with the Director of Rooms and other hotel leaders, you will drive guest satisfaction, develop and motivate the Housekeeping team, and ensure compliance with all hotel policies, procedures, and applicable health and safety regulations. Four Seasons Hotel Riyadh Located in the heart of Riyadh within the iconic Kingdom Tower, Four Seasons Hotel Riyadh offers an exceptional luxury hospitality experience in the Saudi capital. The hotel features elegantly appointed guest rooms and suites, outstanding dining experiences, and world-class facilities, delivering personalized service and genuine care to every guest. As part of the Four Seasons team, you will contribute to creating memorable guest experiences while upholding the highest standards of luxury, service, and operational excellence. Main Tasks and Responsibilities Oversee the overall Housekeeping operation, ensuring the highest standards of cleanliness, presentation, comfort, and maintenance across guest rooms, suites, public areas, and other designated hotel spaces. Develop and implement departmental strategies, operating procedures, and service standards in alignment with Four Seasons policies and brand expectations. Lead, manage, and develop the Housekeeping team, including recruitment, training, performance management, succession planning, and employee engagement. Establish departmental objectives and performance indicators to monitor productivity, service quality, operational efficiency, and guest satisfaction. Develop and manage the Housekeeping department's annual budget, monitor operating expenses, control costs, and identify opportunities to improve financial performance without compromising service quality. Ensure appropriate staffing levels and efficient scheduling to meet occupancy demands, forecasted business levels, and operational requirements. Conduct regular inspections of guest rooms, suites, public areas, and other assigned spaces to ensure compliance with Four Seasons standards and identify opportunities for improvement. Collaborate with the Front Office, Engineering, Laundry, Security, and other departments to ensure smooth daily operations and timely resolution of guest and operational concerns. Monitor guest feedback and satisfaction scores, address complaints professionally, and implement corrective actions to enhance the overall guest experience. Ensure the proper management, inventory, and control of housekeeping supplies, cleaning materials, linen, uniforms, and operating equipment. Establish and maintain effective inventory control procedures to minimize waste, reduce unnecessary expenses, and ensure the availability of required supplies. Ensure compliance with health, safety, hygiene, environmental, and chemical-handling requirements, as well as all applicable hotel policies and procedures. Oversee the implementation of preventive maintenance and deep-cleaning schedules in coordination with Engineering and other relevant departments. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance service delivery, operational processes, employee productivity, and departmental performance. Maintain effective communication with hotel leadership and other department heads to ensure alignment with the hotel's overall business objectives. Promote a culture of accountability, teamwork, professional development, and continuous learning within the Housekeeping department. Identify training needs and ensure that all team members receive appropriate training to perform their duties effectively and consistently meet Four Seasons service standards. Ensure that all housekeeping operations are conducted with discretion, professionalism, and respect for guest privacy and confidentiality. Support sustainability initiatives by promoting the efficient use of water, energy, cleaning materials, and other operational resources. Prepare and present departmental reports, operational updates, budget reviews, and performance analyses to the Director of Rooms and hotel leadership as required. Knowledge and Skills A bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Hospitality Management, Hotel Administration, or a related field is preferred. Significant experience in Housekeeping operations within a luxury hotel environment, including leadership experience at a senior management level. Proven ability to lead, motivate, and develop large teams while maintaining high standards of performance and employee engagement. Strong knowledge of housekeeping operations, cleaning procedures, room inspection standards, public area maintenance, and inventory management. Demonstrated experience in budgeting, cost control, resource planning, and departmental financial management. Excellent organizational, planning, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across departments and levels of the organization. Ability to analyze operational reports, guest feedback, productivity data, and financial performance indicators to support informed decisions. Proficiency in computer applications and hotel operating systems relevant to housekeeping operations. Excellent command of written and spoken English. A strong commitment to guest satisfaction, service excellence, and the Four Seasons culture of genuine care. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment, manage competing priorities, and maintain operational excellence during periods of high occupancy. What to Expect Competitive net salary in a tax-free environment. Housing provided. Transportation allowance. 30 days' vacation. 10 public holidays per year. Paid home-leave tickets. Complimentary employee meals. Medical insurance. Life insurance. Employee Assistance Program. Worldwide complimentary room nights with Four Seasons. Laundry and dry-cleaning services for provided work

fc1faf62b20a5ce6.description: About the Role Asaan | آسان is seeking a Conservation Senior Manager specializing in Objects and Textiles to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is responsible for the daily delivery of conservation services for the organization's collections, ensuring their maintenance, conservation, and availability for various stakeholders. The Senior Manager will work under the direction of the Collections Care Director. Key Responsibilities Implement the collections care and conservation strategy and manage the day-to-day conservation work program. Undertake conservation and preservation work and advise on the development of collection policies and procedures. Provide conservation and maintenance support for all collections, ensuring their integrity and security. Support the development and implementation of a strategic plan for collections care and conservation, identifying new areas for development and monitoring performance against objectives. Manage and direct the Collection Conservation team, fostering a collaborative environment, conducting performance evaluations, and providing professional development opportunities. Encourage and support research and scholarship related to the collections, collaborating with academic institutions and presenting findings. Support public programs and exhibitions, working with education and outreach teams to create engaging content and representing the institution at events. Support the Collections Care Director in identifying funding opportunities, cultivating donor relationships, and preparing grant applications. Assist in developing and managing the Collections Care budget, monitoring expenditures, and ensuring financial accountability for conservation activities. Support the implementation of a Disaster Response Plan and undertake regular risk assessments and environmental control audits. Ensure all collection care activities are recorded in the CMS and that staff are trained in its use for documentation. Manage daily operations of the conservation team and facilities, ensuring compliance and a safe environment. Work with the Collections Care Director to establish and implement long-term storage solutions, including off-site facilities and high-density storage optimization. Liaise with operational teams to ensure building infrastructure supports preservation standards. Experience and Qualifications Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in conservation management, specifically with objects and textiles. The role requires a strong understanding of collection care strategies, preservation techniques, and team leadership. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, involving collaboration with various internal teams and external stakeholders to achieve conservation objectives.

fc4163271fe93030.description: مدير متجر إلكتروني (E-commerce Manager) هل لديك خبرة عميقة في التجارة الإلكترونية وسجل مثبت في تحقيق النمو؟ نبحث عن مدير متجر إلكتروني يقود عملياتنا الرقمية ويصنع فرقًا حقيقيًا في الأداء والإيرادات. عن الدور ستكون مسؤولًا عن قيادة وتشغيل وتطوير المتجر الإلكتروني بشكل متكامل، من العمليات اليومية إلى الاستراتيجيات طويلة المدى، مع تركيز واضح على نمو المبيعات وتحسين تجربة العملاء وتعظيم الكفاءة التشغيلية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إدارة وتشغيل المتجر الإلكتروني بكافة جوانبه (المنتجات، الطلبات، المخزون، الشحن). تطوير وتنفيذ استراتيجيات نمو المبيعات وتحسين الأداء التجاري. تحليل البيانات واستخلاص رؤى تدعم اتخاذ القرار (Conversion، AOV، CAC، LTV). تحسين تجربة المستخدم ورفع معدل التحويل وتقليل التخلي عن السلة. الإشراف على قنوات التسويق الرقمي SEO، الإعلانات، وسائل التواصل، البريد الإلكتروني. إدارة فريق العمل والشركاء الخارجيين (تقنيين، شركات شحن، بوابات دفع). متابعة أداء المنصة وضمان استقرارها وتطويرها المستمر. المؤهلات المطلوبة خبرة لا تقل عن 5 سنوات في إدارة المتاجر الإلكترونية أو التجارة الرقمية. سجل إنجازات مثبت في نمو المبيعات وتحقيق مؤشرات أداء قوية. خبرة في منصات التجارة الإلكترونية مثل سله و زد ، شوبيفاي وماجنتو. مهارات تحليلية قوية واتخاذ قرارات مبنية على البيانات. خبرة في إدارة الحملات التسويقية وتحسين العائد على الاستثمار (ROI). مهارات قيادية واتصالية عالية. سمات شخصية عقلية قيادية تركز على النتائج. شغف بالتجارة الرقمية والتقنيات الحديثة. قدرة على العمل في بيئة سريعة التغير. توجه نحو الابتكار والتحسين المستمر. أمثلة على الإنجازات المتوقعة تحقيق نمو ملحوظ في المبيعات خلال فترة قصيرة. تحسين معدل التحويل وتجربة المستخدم بشكل ملموس. خفض تكلفة اكتساب العملاء وزيادة العائد على الاستثمار. طريقة التقديم إذا كنت ترى نفسك مناسبًا لهذا الدور وتمتلك الخبرة والإنجازات المطلوبة، يسعدنا استقبال سيرتك الذاتية مع أمثلة واضحة على إنجازاتك في التجارة الإلكترونية. انضم إلينا وكن جزءًا من رحلة نمو رقمية تصنع أثرًا حقيقيًا.

fc4f7ee517c6bcd9.description: About Soudal Soudal is Europe's largest independent producer of mastics, adhesives, and PU foams. As a 100% Belgian family business, Soudal has grown into a global player in chemical building specialties, operating 34 production sites across five continents and employing over 4800 individuals. The company's performance is driven by investments in R&D, a vision of innovation, and adaptation to local market needs. The Role of Sales Manager, Saudi Arabia Soudal is seeking a Sales Manager for its Saudi Arabia branch. This full-time position is based in Jeddah and requires frequent travel throughout Saudi Arabia, including regular visits to Dammam and Riyadh. The Sales Manager will be responsible for driving Soudal's market share growth in Saudi Arabia by leading and developing the sales organization and executing a clear commercial strategy. The focus will be on expanding the customer base, strengthening existing relationships, and identifying new opportunities within the building and construction sector for technical and chemical products. Key Responsibilities Lead, coach, and motivate a team of sales representatives to achieve sales and profit targets. Develop and execute short-, mid-, and long-term sales strategies for the Saudi Arabian market. Identify, contact, and develop new customers and market segments to expand business. Build, maintain, and strengthen relationships with key accounts, distributors, contractors, and other stakeholders. Drive new business opportunities while maximizing growth within existing accounts. Monitor sales performance, analyze results, and implement improvement initiatives. Detect market opportunities and translate them into effective sales plans and commercial actions. Identify and develop new market segments within trade and construction. Inform the organization about market trends, customer developments, competitor activities, and channel insights. Contribute to defining the future product portfolio based on customer needs and market opportunities. Plan and oversee commercial and marketing initiatives to support business growth. Prepare and deliver product presentations, training sessions, and sales displays. Spend significant time in the field, traveling across Saudi Arabia to visit customers and support the sales team. Work closely with the Country Manager and cross-functional stakeholders to achieve business objectives. Foster a high-performance culture focused on growth, accountability, teamwork, and customer satisfaction. Key Objectives Achieve agreed sales, profit, and new business targets. Expand Soudal's market share and customer base in Saudi Arabia. Strengthen Soudal's position within the building and construction industry. Drive sustainable growth through strategic account development and market expansion initiatives. Candidate Profile and Requirements Candidates should possess over 10 years of relevant experience. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong entrepreneurial and commercial thinking with a 'Hunter' profile, focusing on results and achievement. This role requires a strategic thinker with a hands-on mentality, strong analytical skills, and problem-solving abilities to meet deadlines and manage pressure. A high level of drive, energy, and enthusiasm is essential for persistence in this role. Compensation and Work Environment Soudal offers a challenging position within a growing subsidiary of the Soudal Group. The Group is financially solid, multinational, and independent, with a dynamic team that has shown strong growth. A competitive remuneration package will be provided for this role.

fc6d558e269338ac.description: About the Role Yamama Cement is seeking a Senior Mechanic to join its team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves performing essential mechanical maintenance to ensure the efficient operation of production units and equipment within the facility. Key Responsibilities Perform routine, preventive, and emergency mechanical maintenance in adherence to approved policies and procedures. Monitor the performance of production units to ensure operation within designated limits and report any observations affecting equipment efficiency. Identify necessary tools and equipment for maintenance, assess their readiness, and conduct preventive maintenance to ensure continuous availability. Organize and store maintenance tools in their designated locations, maintain them properly, and ensure appropriate disposal of maintenance waste. Execute mechanical repair tasks, including welding, cutting, and refurbishing replaced parts to ensure their readiness and efficiency. Comply with all safety procedures before commencing work, including verifying required permits and lockout/tagout forms. Undertake any other tasks assigned by the direct supervisor. Work Environment The Senior Mechanic will operate within the industrial environment of Yamama Cement, contributing to the operational integrity of the plant's mechanical systems. The role is based in Riyadh and is a full-time position. Application Process Candidates interested in this Senior Mechanic position are encouraged to apply. Further details regarding the application process will be provided upon inquiry.

fca4fb463e62ad7a.description: About the Role Thermo Fisher Scientific is seeking a FSP Local Clinical Trial Manager (CTM) to manage clinical studies locally in Saudi Arabia for one of its clients. This full-time role involves overseeing clinical deliverables for projects of low to moderate complexity, ensuring adherence to contractual obligations and quality standards. Role Purpose and Scope The Clinical Trial Manager is responsible for achieving the final clinical deliverable, typically clean data from evaluable patients as defined in the study protocol, within the timeframe specified in the customer contract. This position involves interpreting data on project issues, making informed business decisions with support, and ensuring all clinical deliverables meet customer expectations regarding time, quality, and cost. The CTM maintains profitability by ensuring clinical activity is conducted within the contract scope through efficient management of the clinical team. Key Responsibilities Manage all clinical operational and quality aspects of allocated studies, of low to moderate complexity, in compliance with ICH GCP. May assume Clinical Study Manager (CSM) responsibilities on smaller or less complex projects. Develop clinical tools such as Monitoring Plans and Monitoring Guidelines in conjunction with the Data Quality Plan. Contribute to the Master Action Plan (MAP) for clinical-related documents. Ensure timely setup, organization, content, and quality of relevant sections of the Trial Master File (local and central). May participate in the design of CRFs, CRF guidelines, and patient informed consent templates. Collaborate with the project manager to prepare, organize, and present at client meetings, including bid defense and hand-off meetings. Communicate regularly with the clinical team and lead team meetings to ensure timelines, resources, interactions, and quality are maintained. Implement and train on standardized clinical monitoring processes within the study and according to corporate standard policies. Ensure timely archiving of documents and study materials for the department. Monitor clinical activity timelines and metrics, provide status updates to the project manager, review projects using tracking tools, implement recovery actions, review monitoring visit reports, and manage CRF collection and query resolution. Continuously monitor or co-monitor clinical trials to assess performance and ensure contractual obligations are met. In smaller regions, may routinely conduct Accompanied Field Visits (AFVs) and be accountable for project financials. Communicate with study sites regarding issues such as protocol, patient participation, and case report form completion. Coordinate all start-up activities and ensure timely ethics committee and regulatory submissions are addressed. Review and follow up on questions raised by ethics committees. Provide input into the preparation of forecast estimates for clinical activities. fcbe61798dac188e.description: Sanabil Studio is a venture builder that blends industry expertise, technology, and startup know-how to turn bold ideas into real businesses. Whoever closes that gap wins the market. We are a B2B marketplace that supplies large garages in Riyadh with spare parts from vetted wholesalers, owning the ordering, delivery, and, critically, the payments. We give garages workable terms and pay suppliers, carrying the collection risk no one else will. We are the founding team building this venture from concept to a licensed, scaling business, starting with a Riyadh pilot. We are looking for a Co-Founder & Chief Commercial Officer to lead the venture. Build and own the demand side: sign, onboard, and grow a base of large garages, and own B2B field sales. Build and lead the founding team and the key relationships: wholesalers, garage chains, insurers, and the studio / IC. THE PROFILE: You're probably a fit if… You have 8-12+ years in commercial, GM, or founder roles in the auto aftermarket, B2B distribution/trading, or industrial supply, ideally in KSA/GCC. You have personally signed both suppliers and customers and grown a two-sided or distribution business (a verifiable track record, not just "exposure to"). You deeply understand how the Saudi auto-parts trade actually buys, prices, and pays, and you already have a Riyadh wholesaler/garage/insurer network. You have led a P&L and built and run a team. You communicate clearly with suppliers, garages, insurers, and the studio/board. You are fluent in Arabic and English and based in Riyadh. Bonus: existing relationships with large chains (e.g., Petromin), insurers (e.g., Tawuniya, Najm) or major wholesalers; familiarity with CR / ZATCA / licensing. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE: Within the first 12 months, you'll... Have signed a working base of suppliers and garages and taken the marketplace live at a target monthly order volume. Have delivered validated unit economics and ≥80% on-time collection across live orders. Have hired the core team and established a clear operating cadence. Have a credible path to a licensed, scaling business and the next funding milestone. Be recognised as a decisive leader who aligns the team, partners, and the studio. WHAT THE VENTURE PROVIDES Validated thesis, financial model and market sizing: a de-risked concept with the commercial playbook. fcce4950c6df64d3.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة التعمير والانشاء عن مهندس معماري للانضمام إلى فريقها في الخبر، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور على تصميم ومراجعة المخططات المعمارية للمشاريع الإنشائية، مع ضمان مطابقتها لمتطلبات العملاء والمعايير الفنية. كما يتضمن الإشراف على تنفيذ الأعمال المعمارية في الموقع لضمان الجودة والالتزام بالجداول الزمنية للمشروع. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد ومراجعة المخططات والتصاميم المعمارية للمشاريع. التنسيق الفعال مع المهندسين المدنيين والكهربائيين والميكانيكيين لضمان تكامل التصاميم. مراجعة الرسومات التنفيذية (Shop Drawings) واعتمادها. الإشراف المباشر على الأعمال المعمارية في الموقع والتأكد من مطابقتها للمخططات والمواصفات المعتمدة. متابعة تقدم الأعمال وإعداد التقارير الدورية اللازمة. حصر الكميات ومراجعة المستخلصات المتعلقة بالأعمال المعمارية. المشاركة في اجتماعات المشروع مع العملاء والاستشاريين والمقاولين الفرعيين. التأكد من الالتزام باشتراطات البناء والكودات المعتمدة ومعايير الجودة والسلامة. معالجة الملاحظات الفنية واقتراح الحلول المناسبة أثناء مرحلة التنفيذ. مراجعة واعتماد المواد والتشطيبات المعمارية المقدمة من الموردين. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الهندسة المعمارية. القدرة على تصميم ومراجعة المخططات المعمارية. معرفة جيدة بالكودات والمواصفات الفنية للمشاريع الإنشائية. مهارات الإشراف على تنفيذ الأعمال المعمارية في الموقع. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة الخبر بالمنطقة الشرقية. سيعمل المهندس المعماري ضمن فريق متخصص، مما يتطلب مهارات تنسيق وتعاون عالية لضمان سير المشاريع بكفاءة. معلومات إضافية تلتزم شركة التعمير والانشاء بتوفير بيئة عمل احترافية تدعم النمو المهني. لم يتم الكشف عن الراتب لهذا المنصب.

fcfd6b640ec95748.description: Job Brief We are looking for an experienced and reliable Chief Accountant to oversee the company's accounting operations and ensure accurate financial reporting and proper financial controls. You will manage day-to-day accounting activities, monitor financial transactions, prepare reports, and support management with accurate and timely financial information. This role is important for maintaining financial accuracy, compliance, and the smooth operation of the company's finance function. Key Responsibilities • Oversee daily accounting operations, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger, and cash transactions. • Ensure all financial transactions are recorded accurately and in a timely manner. • Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and management reports. • Monitor cash flow, bank balances, receivables, payables, and other financial activities. • Perform regular bank, ledger, and account reconciliations and investigate discrepancies. • Review invoices, payments, expenses, and supporting documents for accuracy and proper authorization. • Maintain accurate and organized accounting records in accordance with company policies and applicable regulations. • Assist with budgeting, forecasting, financial planning, and cost control activities. • Coordinate with external auditors, tax consultants, banks, and other financial institutions when required. • Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, tax requirements, and local financial regulations. • Monitor internal financial controls and recommend improvements where necessary. • Provide management with financial analysis, reports, and information to support business decisions. • Supervise and support accounting staff and ensure accounting tasks are completed accurately and on schedule. • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field is preferred. • Professional accounting qualification such as ACCA, CPA, CMA, or equivalent is an advantage. • Proven experience in accounting, with previous experience in a senior or supervisory accounting role preferred. • Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial reporting, reconciliations, and internal controls. • Good knowledge of accounting software and Microsoft Excel. • Strong attention to detail, organization, and numerical accuracy. • Good communication and problem-solving skills. • Able to manage deadlines, work independently, and handle confidential financial information professionally.

fc2c1404a15c1ea9.description: We are looking for a skilled and hands-on Maintenance Supervisor to join the production team of a fast-growing company operating across multiple markets. You will play a key role in ensuring the reliability, safety, and performance of the facility’s equipment and infrastructure, with particular ownership of refrigeration and HVAC systems that are critical to day-to-day production. In this role, you will oversee equipment installation, commissioning, preventive maintenance, and breakdown response across the facility. You will lead a team of technicians, manage external contractors and suppliers, and ensure critical systems remain operational and compliant. You will also take ownership of the maintenance budget and asset strategy, proactively addressing equipment risks before they impact production. Responsibilities Lead the installation, commissioning, and handover of new or upgraded kitchen and production equipment. Oversee and prioritize the work of the facility’s maintenance and technician team. Develop and manage preventive maintenance schedules across production, refrigeration, HVAC, and facility equipment. Respond quickly to equipment breakdowns and coordinate repairs to minimize production downtime. Maintain accurate maintenance logs, equipment records, service histories, and inspection documentation. Own the performance and reliability of refrigeration and HVAC systems across the facility. Ensure refrigeration and cold-storage systems consistently support required cold-chain and food-safety standards. Work closely with the Quality team on equipment issues that may have food-safety or product-quality implications. Manage the facility’s maintenance budget and monitor spending against planned requirements. Maintain an accurate asset register and plan equipment replacement and capital expenditure ahead of end-of-life. Build and manage a reliable network of qualified contractors and specialist maintenance vendors. Negotiate and manage service agreements, SLAs, callout requirements, and response times with external providers. Lead root-cause investigations into recurring equipment failures and implement long-term engineering or process improvements. Ensure mechanical, electrical, refrigeration, and facility systems meet required safety and regulatory standards. Keep all required equipment certifications, inspections, and compliance records up to date. Identify potential equipment and infrastructure risks and proactively address them before they affect production. Work closely with production and kitchen leadership to ensure maintenance activities are planned with minimal operational disruption. Maintain a safe, organized, and reliable working environment across the facility. 5-6 years of experience in maintenance, engineering, or facilities management within a food production, manufacturing, industrial, or similar environment. Strong hands-on experience with industrial equipment maintenance. Experience with refrigeration and HVAC systems is strongly preferred. Experience leading equipment installation and commissioning projects. Previous experience managing or supervising a team of technicians. Strong knowledge of preventive and corrective maintenance practices. Ability to troubleshoot equipment failures and lead effective root-cause investigations. Experience managing external contractors, maintenance vendors, and service agreements. Comfortable managing maintenance budgets, assets, and capital replacement planning. Strong understanding of mechanical, electrical, refrigeration, and facility safety requirements. Experience working in an environment where equipment uptime and production continuity are critical. Strong organizational skills with excellent attention to detail and record-keeping. Proactive approach to identifying and preventing equipment failures. Strong communication and team-management skills. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced production environment where quick response to operational issues is required.

fc59724ab3654819.description: We are seeking an experienced Electrical Construction Manager to lead and manage industrial electrical and E&I construction projects from mobilization and installation through testing, commissioning, energization, and final client handover. Key Responsibilities Plan, manage, and supervise industrial electrical construction projects. Lead installation of MV/LV substations, transformers, switchgear, MCCs, and switchyards . Supervise cable laying, jointing, termination, testing, and energization activities. Oversee installation of motors, pumps, VFDs, protection, metering, and control systems . Coordinate PLC, SCADA, instrumentation, and communication-system works. Review electrical drawings, specifications, BOQs, method statements, and project schedules. Support planning teams with construction plans, manpower requirements, and material forecasts. Manage engineers, technicians, labor teams, and subcontractors. Coordinate with clients, consultants, vendors, and other engineering disciplines. Monitor project progress, productivity, cost, quality, and schedule performance . Ensure compliance with approved drawings, project specifications, and applicable standards. Enforce HSE requirements, permit-to-work procedures, and safe working practices. Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering from a recognized university. 15+ years of experience in industrial electrical construction projects. Extensive experience with MV/LV systems, substations, transformers, switchgear, MCCs, cables, motors, protection, and control systems . Strong experience in installation, testing, commissioning, energization, and project handover . Proven experience managing multidisciplinary teams, subcontractors, project schedules, costs, quality, and HSE requirements . A senior electrical construction professional with strong hands-on project leadership experience across industrial electrical systems, capable of managing construction activities, teams, subcontractors, and client coordination while delivering projects safely, on schedule, and to specification.

Our culture is built on the relentless pursuit of excellence and meaningful impact. If you’re passionate about working alongside exceptional talent on world-class AI, and you want the autonomy and runway to do the best work of your career, join us in shaping the future of intelligent enterprises. As a member of Mozn's Data Science team, you will work with cross-disciplinary teams to identify the problems to be solved, specify the problems in mathematical and statistical terms, scope out the project in collaboration with your team and external stakeholders, and then go about answering the identified questions. You find insights that spur teams and stakeholders to improve their business/product and drive value for internal and external stakeholders. Analyze and extract insights from multiple and complex datasets through regression analysis, hypothesis testing, and other machine learning techniques. Develop and apply new machine learning techniques to ensure modern yet optimal approaches are applied to Mozn's solutions. Plan and execute end-to-end data science projects, from data collection and exploration through model development, deployment, and intelligent decision-making. Engage with stakeholders to identify and define the scope of challenges and propose data-powered solutions. Staying informed with new frameworks and technological advances to increase Mozn's efficiency and productivity. Deploy and maintain AI and machine learning models across on-prem, cloud, and hybrid environments. Programming experience over three years, including data manipulation using Python or other languages. Good understanding of statistics and probability, such as Bayesian methods and conditional probability. Applied experience in machine learning, such as conducting model experiments. We believe strength lies in difference, embracing all for who they are and empowered to be the best version of themselves.

Key Responsibilities: Deploy, manage, and maintain Red Hat Satellite instances for systems provisioning, configuration management, patching and monitoring. Automate repetitive tasks using scripting languages such as Bash or Python to enhance operational efficiency. Monitor system performance, perform routine upgrades, and troubleshoot issues related to RHEL systems. Implement and enforce best practices for security and compliance within Linux environments. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify opportunities for process improvements and automation. Document system configurations, procedures, and changes for future reference. Provide technical support and troubleshooting for Linux servers and related applications. Assist in the planning and execution of system upgrades, migrations, and new deployments. Experience with ITIL processes and methodologies. Familiarity with database management and monitoring tools. Ability to work in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment. We will check in to confirm your availability and interest. Our hiring teams carefully vet and select top candidates who best meet project needs, ensuring that you are matched with the right opportunity when it becomes available. Collaborate with game designers, artists, and programmers to define audio requirements and integrate assets effectively. Record, edit, and mix high-quality sound effects and voice-over content. Create and manage audio assets using middleware tools like Wwise or FMOD. Implement spatial audio, adaptive music systems, and sound design elements to support an immersive experience. Debug and optimize audio for performance across multiple platforms. Provide innovative audio solutions to creative challenges in gameplay and narrative. Maintain consistency in audio quality and style across all aspects of the project. Experience : 3+ years of professional experience as an Audio Designer in the video game industry. Demonstrated contribution to at least one shipped title on PC, console, mobile, or VR/AR. Technical Skills : Proficiency with audio middleware such as Wwise or FMOD. Expertise in sound design, recording, editing, and mixing. Familiarity with DAWs (Digital Audio Workstations) such as Pro Tools, Logic Pro, or Reaper. Basic understanding of game engines like Unreal Engine or Unity for audio integration. Knowledge of audio file optimization and compression techniques. Creative and Collaborative Skills : Strong storytelling abilities through audio. Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively in cross-disciplinary teams. Attention to detail and a commitment to delivering exceptional audio experiences. Passion for Gaming : Genuine enthusiasm for sound design in video games and a strong understanding of the role of audio in enhancing gameplay.
